text:
Chelsea transfer news: Blues will push to sign Bournemouth midfielder Alex Scott in January - Paper Talk
Plus: Maxence Lacroix is hoping to give Chelsea a boost by returning from injury before the end of the year; Newcastle are moving closer to building a new stadium on Leazes Park; Rugby Premiership side Bristol Bears are in advanced talks to sign All Blacks star Beauden Barrett
Tuesday 24 November 2026 23:21, UK
The top stories and transfer rumours from Tuesday's newspapers...
CHELSEA
Chelsea will push to sign Bournemouth and England midfielder Alex Scott in the January transfer window - The Mirror
Maxence Lacroix is hoping to give Xabi Alonso a boost by returning from injury before the end of the year as the Chelsea manager attempts to turn back the clock to win over worried supporters - The Telegraph
Wesley Fofana has laughed off his penalty miss against Liverpool in an unauthorised interview that risks upsetting Chelsea and sparking a backlash from unhappy supporters - The Times

PREMIER LEAGUE
Newcastle United are moving closer to building a new stadium on Leazes Park that would completely transform the surrounding area - The Telegraph
FIFA
Chris Martin, the Coldplay frontman, gave Gianni Infantino a baby grand piano as a personal gift before curating the first World Cup final half-time show - The Telegraph
WOMEN'S FOOTBALL
England, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales are in the dark about whether they will be granted automatic qualification as hosts for the 2035 Women's World Cup - The Guardian
RUGBY UNION
Bristol Bears are in advanced talks to sign All Blacks superstar Beauden Barrett, with the double World Player of the Year being offered a two-year contract - Daily Mail
CRICKET
Australian cricketers hatched plans to tamper with the ball during their first Test after Sandpapergate, according to anonymous sources, but the attempt was stopped by then-captain Tim Paine - News Corp
TENNIS
Tennis star Ben Shelton and soccer sensation Trinity Rodman have split after almost two years together - Daily Mail
digest_he: לקראת חלון ההעברות בחודש ינואר, צ'לסי מתכננת להאיץ את המאמצים לצרף את קשר בורנמות' ונבחרת אנגליה, אלכס סקוט. במקביל, מקסנס לאקרואה מקווה לחזור מפציעה לפני סוף השנה כדי לסייע למאמן צ'לסי.ברוסטר בריסטול בירס מנהלים שיחות מתקדמות להחתמת כוכב האול בלאקס בודן בארט על חוזה לשנתיים. בנוסף, ניוקאסל יונייטד מקדמת את התוכניות לבניית אצטדיון חדש, וגורמים שונים דיווחו על התפתחויות בענפי ספורט נוספים.
